title: Bioelectric networks lead from cell homeostasis to cognition

statements.text: Developmental bioelectricity, the ability of all cells to form electrical networks that process information, provides gradual evolutionary steps from single-cell homeostasis to memory, prediction and complex cognitive agents.

sources.quote: suggest a plausible set of gradual evolutionary steps that naturally lead from physiological homeostasis in single cells to memory, prediction, and ultimately complex cognitive agents
